SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE

COLONOSCOPY REPORT
Patient: Synthetic Patient (fictional), 58-year-old man
Date of service: November 9, 2026
Endoscopist: A. Current, MD (fictional)
Sedation: Monitored anesthesia care by the anesthesia team

Indication: Surveillance colonoscopy.

FINDINGS
The colonoscope was advanced to the cecum; the appendiceal orifice and ileocecal valve were identified. A 12 mm sessile polyp in the transverse colon could not be captured with a cold snare on the first attempt; after repositioning, it was captured and removed en bloc with the cold snare and retrieved.

IMPRESSION
12 mm transverse colon polyp removed with a cold snare.
